ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance estimated at 75% coverage versus 25% low-intensity black/dark gray bordering and central regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central lobes; low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the lower center and along the trailing edge perimeters; prominent ochre/yellowish-brown geometric blobs distributed across the upper-inner regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex angle; vertical depth relative to lobe height is approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; right distal tip shows acute jagged peaks; left inner trailing edge contains a significant high-amplitude U-shaped indentation/missing section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave trailing edge geometry sweeping towards tapered distal tips; bottom leading edge exhibits a smooth convex curve transitioning from the center.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular, three-dimensional pixel groups concentrated on the extreme right and left distal tips; isolated circular white spots visible on the left lobe mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-pixel linear markings (rake marks) traversing the lower central region and left lobe, breaking the white pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular loss of tissue/indentation on the upper-left trailing edge; dense barnacle colonization on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown surface staining across the upper-middle regions of both ventral lobes.
